utf8_to_wide_n.brief: 把前 `len` 字节 UTF-8 转成 UTF-16 / Convert the first `len` bytes of UTF-8 to UTF-16

params.s: UTF-8 源文本 / Source UTF-8 text
params.len: 参与转换的字节数 / Number of bytes to convert
params.out: out:接收宽字符的缓冲 / Receives the wide characters
params.out_count: 宽字符缓冲容量（含结尾） / Capacity in wide chars, including the terminator

utf8_to_wide_n.return: 写入的宽字符数 / Number of wide characters written

retval.0: `len <= 0` 或转换失败 / `len <= 0` or conversion failed

utf8_to_wide_n.note: 直接封装的 `MultiByteToWideChar`，不做 NUL 终止 / Thin wrapper over `MultiByteToWideChar`, no NUL termination

utf8_to_wide.brief: 把以 NUL 结尾的 UTF-8 文本转成 UTF-16 / Convert a NUL-terminated UTF-8 string to UTF-16

params.s: UTF-8 源文本，可为 NULL / Source UTF-8 text, may be NULL
params.out: out:接收宽字符的缓冲 / Receives the wide characters
params.out_count: 宽字符缓冲容量（含结尾） / Capacity in wide chars, including the terminator

utf8_to_wide.note: `s` 为 NULL 或容量不足 2 时只写出结尾 NUL / With `s` NULL or capacity below 2 only the terminating NUL is written

hope_register_class.brief: 注册共享窗口类（每进程一次）/ Register the shared window class once per process
hope_register_class.return: 注册成功或此前已注册返回 1，失败返回 0 / 1 when registered or already registered, 0 on failure

retval.1: 类已可用 / The class is usable
retval.0: `RegisterClassExW` 失败，已打印错误 / `RegisterClassExW` failed and an error was printed

hope_register_class.note: 幂等：用静态标志保证只注册一次 / Idempotent: a static flag makes registration happen only once

hope_create_hwnd.brief: 创建容纳 `width`×`height` 客户区像素的 OS 窗口 / Create an OS window sized for a `width`×`height` client area

params.title: 窗口标题，NULL 时用 `Hope` / Window title, defaults to `Hope` when NULL
params.win: 作为创建参数透传给窗口过程的窗口对象 / Window object passed through as the creation parameter
params.width: 客户区宽度（像素）/ Client width in pixels
params.height: 客户区高度（像素）/ Client height in pixels

hope_create_hwnd.return: 新窗口句柄，失败返回 NULL / The new window handle, NULL on failure
hope_create_hwnd.note: 用 `AdjustWindowRect` 把客户区尺寸换算成含边框的窗口尺寸 / `AdjustWindowRect` expands the client size into the full frame size

hpe_window_create.brief: 创建平台窗口并绑定回调 / Create a platform window and bind its callbacks

params.title: 窗口标题 / Window title
params.width: 客户区宽度，最小 64 像素 / Client width, clamped to at least 64 pixels
params.height: 客户区高度，最小 64 像素 / Client height, clamped to at least 64 pixels
params.callbacks: 窗口回调表，NULL 表示全部为空 / Callback table, NULL means all callbacks are empty
params.user: 透传给每个回调的用户数据 / User data passed to every callback

hpe_window_create.return: 新窗口对象，失败返回 NULL / The new window object, NULL on failure
hpe_window_create.note: 先调用 `SetProcessDPIAware`，随后显示窗口；若设置了 `on_tick` 则启动 15 毫秒定时器 / Calls `SetProcessDPIAware`, shows the window, and starts a 15 ms timer when `on_tick` is set

hpe_window_present.brief: 提交一帧 BGRA 像素并请求重绘 / Present one BGRA frame and request a repaint

params.win: 目标窗口，NULL 时直接返回 / Target window, returns early when NULL
params.bgra_pixels: BGRA32 像素数据 / BGRA32 pixel data
params.stride_bytes: 每行字节数 / Bytes per row

hpe_window_present.note: 只登记缓冲与尺寸并调用 `InvalidateRect`，真正的拷贝发生在 `WM_PAINT` / Stores the buffer and size and calls `InvalidateRect`; the actual copy happens in `WM_PAINT`

hpe_window_set_title.brief: 设置窗口标题栏文本 / Set the window caption text

params.title: 新的标题文本（UTF-8）/ New caption text in UTF-8
params.win: 目标窗口，NULL 或无句柄时直接返回 / Target window, returns early when NULL or without a handle

hpe_window_invalidate.brief: 请求重绘整个客户区 / Request a repaint of the whole client area

params.win: 目标窗口，NULL 或无句柄时直接返回 / Target window, returns early when NULL or without a handle

hpe_window_request_close.brief: 异步请求关闭窗口 / Ask the window to close asynchronously

params.win: 目标窗口，NULL 或无句柄时直接返回 / Target window, returns early when NULL or without a handle

hpe_window_request_close.note: 投递 `WM_CLOSE`，消息循环随后退出 / Posts `WM_CLOSE`; the message loop then exits

hope_mods.brief: 读取当前修饰键状态 / Read the current modifier-key state
hope_mods.return: `HPE_MOD_CTRL/SHIFT/ALT` 的位掩码 / Bit mask of `HPE_MOD_CTRL/SHIFT/ALT`
hope_mods.note: 用 `GetKeyState` 的高位判断，供输入消息处理时抓取即时状态 / Tests the high bit of `GetKeyState` to capture the state at input-message time

hope_blit.brief: 把已登记的像素缓冲拷到窗口 / Copy the registered pixel buffer to the window

params.win: 目标窗口，NULL 或无句柄时直接返回 / Target window, returns early when NULL or without a handle

hope_blit.note: 自顶向下的 32 位 DIB，用 `StretchDIBits` 只画脏矩形；无像素时填黑 / A top-down 32-bit DIB painted with `StretchDIBits` over the damaged rect; fills black when there are no pixels

hope_on_mouse.brief: 处理鼠标消息并派发 `on_mouse` / Handle a mouse message and dispatch `on_mouse`

params.hwnd: 窗口句柄，用于捕获指针 / Window handle used for pointer capture
params.lparam: 消息附加参数，低／高 16 位为客户端 x、y / Message LParam whose low/high words are client x and y
params.button: 鼠标按键（0 左键，-1 表示纯移动）/ Mouse button (0 = left, -1 = bare move)
params.down: 按下为 1、抬起为 0 / 1 when pressed, 0 when released

hope_on_mouse.note: 左键按下时 `SetCapture`、抬起时 `ReleaseCapture`，使拖选能走出窗口 / Calls `SetCapture` on left-down and `ReleaseCapture` on left-up so a drag can leave the window

hope_on_char.brief: 把已输入的字符派发给 `on_char` / Dispatch a typed character to `on_char`

params.wparam: 消息主参数，即 UTF-16 码元 / Message WParam, the UTF-16 code unit

hope_on_char.note: 跳过控制字符（按 VK 处理）与代理项，只上报基本平面码点 / Skips control characters (handled as VK_*) and surrogates, reporting only BMP code points

hope_wnd_dispatch.brief: 把窗口消息映射到回调 / Map window messages onto engine callbacks

params.msg: 窗口消息编号 / Window message identifier
params.lparam: 消息附加参数 / Message LParam

hope_wnd_dispatch.return: 处理结果为 0，`WM_ERASEBKGND` 返回 1，其余交给 `DefWindowProcW` / 0 for handled messages, 1 for `WM_ERASEBKGND`, otherwise `DefWindowProcW`
hope_wnd_dispatch.note: 处理绘制、尺寸、滚轮、按键、字符、鼠标与定时器消息 / Handles paint, size, wheel, key, char, mouse and timer messages

hope_wnd_proc.brief: 共享窗口类的主窗口过程 / Main window procedure of the shared window class

params.msg: 窗口消息编号 / Window message identifier
params.lparam: 消息附加参数 / Message LParam

hope_wnd_proc.return: 消息处理结果 / The message handling result
hope_wnd_proc.note: `WM_CREATE` 时把创建参数存入 `GWLP_USERDATA`；未找到窗口对象则交回 `DefWindowProcW` / Stores the creation parameter in `GWLP_USERDATA` on `WM_CREATE`; falls back to `DefWindowProcW` when no window object is found

hpe_window_run.brief: 进入消息循环直到窗口关闭 / Run the message loop until the window closes

params.win: 目标窗口，NULL 时直接返回 1 / Target window, returns 1 immediately when NULL

hpe_window_run.return: `WM_QUIT` 携带的退出码 / The exit code carried by `WM_QUIT`
hpe_window_run.note: 阻塞式循环，`GetMessageW` 返回 0 时结束 / A blocking loop that ends when `GetMessageW` returns 0

hpe_window_destroy.brief: 销毁窗口并释放窗口对象 / Destroy the window and free the window object

params.win: 目标窗口，NULL 时直接返回 / Target window, returns early when NULL

hpe_window_destroy.note: 先停掉定时器再 `DestroyWindow`，最后释放结构体 / Kills the timer, calls `DestroyWindow`, then frees the struct

hpe_time_seconds.brief: 读取单调时钟秒数 / Read monotonic seconds
hpe_time_seconds.return: 自某个未指定起点起的单调秒数 / Monotonic seconds since an unspecified origin
hpe_time_seconds.note: 基于 `QueryPerformanceCounter`，频率只查询一次并缓存 / Uses `QueryPerformanceCounter`; the frequency is queried once and cached

hpe_time_epoch_ms.brief: 读取自 Unix 纪元起的 UTC 墙钟毫秒 / Read UTC wall-clock milliseconds since the Unix epoch
hpe_time_epoch_ms.return: 自 1970-01-01 UTC 起的毫秒数 / Milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC
hpe_time_epoch_ms.note: 由 `FILETIME`（自 1601 起的 100 纳秒刻度）换算到 Unix 纪元 / Derived from `FILETIME` (100 ns ticks since 1601) shifted to the Unix epoch

hpe_read_file.brief: 读取整个文件到新分配的缓冲 / Read a whole file into a freshly allocated buffer

params.out_size: out:接收读入的字节数，可为 NULL / Receives the byte count read, may be NULL

hpe_read_file.return: 以 NUL 结尾的内容缓冲，失败返回 NULL / NUL-terminated contents buffer, NULL on failure

retval.NULL: 打开、定位或长度获取失败 / Opening, seeking or sizing failed

hpe_read_file.note: 调用方需用 `hpe_free` 释放；开头的 UTF-8 BOM 会被剥掉 / The caller must `hpe_free` it; a leading UTF-8 BOM is stripped

hpe_path_dir.brief: 取出路径的目录部分 / Take the directory part of a path

params.out: out:接收目录的缓冲 / Receives the directory
params.out_size: 接收缓冲区容量 / Capacity of the output buffer

hpe_path_dir.note: 无分隔符时写出 `.`；结果为空时写出 `/` / Writes `.` when there is no separator, and `/` when the result would be empty

hpe_path_is_absolute.brief: 判断路径是否为绝对路径 / Test whether a path is absolute

params.path: 待检查路径 / Path to check

hpe_path_is_absolute.return: 绝对路径返回 1，否则 0 / 1 for an absolute path, 0 otherwise
hpe_path_is_absolute.note: 识别前导 `/`、`\` 以及盘符形式如 `C:` / Recognises a leading `/`, `\`, or a drive prefix such as `C:`

hpe_path_join.brief: 把相对路径接到目录上 / Join a relative path onto a directory

params.out: out:接收拼接结果的缓冲 / Receives the joined path
params.out_size: 接收缓冲区容量 / Capacity of the output buffer

hpe_path_join.note: 先剥掉开头的 `./`；若 `rel` 已是绝对路径或 `dir` 为空则只用 `rel` / Strips leading `./`; uses `rel` alone when it is absolute or `dir` is empty

hpe_path_absolute.brief: 把路径解析为绝对路径 / Resolve a path to an absolute one

params.out: out:接收绝对路径的缓冲 / Receives the absolute path
params.out_size: 接收缓冲区容量 / Capacity of the output buffer

hpe_path_absolute.note: 用 `GetFullPathNameA` 相对当前工作目录解析，并把反斜杠统一成正斜杠；失败时原样拷回 / Resolves against the process working directory with `GetFullPathNameA` and normalises backslashes to slashes; copies the input through unchanged on failure

wide_to_utf8_dup.brief: 把 UTF-16 复制成新分配的 UTF-8 串 / Duplicate UTF-16 into a freshly allocated UTF-8 string

params.w: UTF-16 源文本，NULL 时返回 NULL / Source UTF-16 text, returns NULL when NULL
params.len: 宽字符个数，`<= 0` 时用 `lstrlenW` 求长 / Wide-character count, measured with `lstrlenW` when `<= 0`

wide_to_utf8_dup.return: 调用方负责释放的 UTF-8 副本，失败返回 NULL / UTF-8 copy owned by the caller, NULL on failure

hpe_clipboard_get_text.brief: 取剪贴板文本或首个文件路径 / Read clipboard text or the first file path
hpe_clipboard_get_text.return: 以 UTF-8 编码的剪贴板内容（需 `hpe_free`），无文本时返回 NULL / UTF-8 clipboard contents (needs `hpe_free`), NULL when there is no text
hpe_clipboard_get_text.note: 优先读 `CF_UNICODETEXT`；若只有 `CF_HDROP`（资源管理器复制的文件）则返回首个文件路径，便于地址栏使用 / Prefers `CF_UNICODETEXT`; falls back to the first file path in `CF_HDROP` (files copied in Explorer) as an address bar expects

hpe_clipboard_set_text.brief: 用 UTF-8 文本替换剪贴板内容 / Replace the clipboard contents with UTF-8 text

params.utf8: 待写入的 UTF-8 文本，NULL 视为空串 / UTF-8 text to write, NULL is treated as an empty string

hpe_clipboard_set_text.return: 成功返回 1，失败返回 0 / 1 on success, 0 on failure

retval.0: 转换、分配或打开剪贴板失败 / Conversion, allocation or opening the clipboard failed

hpe_clipboard_set_text.note: 以 UTF-16 形式写入；失败时释放临时内存（成功则剪贴板接管）/ Writes as UTF-16; frees the temporary memory on failure (on success the clipboard takes ownership)

hpe_plat_font_create.brief: 创建 GDI 字体句柄 / Create a GDI font handle

params.pixel_size: 字号（像素），取整并夹在 6..240 / Font size in pixels, rounded and clamped to 6..240
params.weight: 字重，`>= 700` 用粗体 / Font weight, uses bold when `>= 700`
params.family: 字体族，决定实际字体名 / Font family, selects the actual typeface

hpe_plat_font_create.return: 新字体对象，失败返回 NULL / The new font object, NULL on failure
hpe_plat_font_create.note: 为内存 DC 选入字体并读出上伸部、下伸部与行高 / Selects the font into a memory DC and reads ascent, descent and line height

hpe_plat_font_destroy.brief: 销毁字体对象并释放 GDI 资源 / Destroy a font object and release its GDI resources

params.font: 待销毁的字体，NULL 时直接返回 / Font to destroy, returns early when NULL

hpe_plat_font_destroy.note: 先恢复原字体再删除 DC 与字体对象 / Restores the previous font before deleting the DC and the font object

hpe_plat_font_ascent.brief: 取字体的上伸部 / Get the font ascent

params.font: 字体对象，NULL 时返回 0 / Font object, returns 0 when NULL

hpe_plat_font_ascent.return: 上伸部像素数 / Ascent in pixels

hpe_plat_font_descent.brief: 取字体的下伸部 / Get the font descent

params.font: 字体对象，NULL 时返回 0 / Font object, returns 0 when NULL

hpe_plat_font_descent.return: 下伸部像素数 / Descent in pixels

hpe_plat_font_line_height.brief: 取字体的行高 / Get the font line height

params.font: 字体对象，NULL 时返回 0 / Font object, returns 0 when NULL

hpe_plat_font_line_height.return: 行高像素数（含外部行距）/ Line height in pixels, including external leading

cp_to_wchars.brief: 把码点编码为 UTF-16 码元 / Encode a code point into UTF-16 code units

params.cp: Unicode 码点 / Unicode code point
params.out: out:接收 1 或 2 个宽字符的数组 / Receives one or two wide characters

cp_to_wchars.return: 写出的宽字符个数 / Number of wide characters written

retval.1: 基本平面码点 / A BMP code point
retval.2: 补充平面码点，写成代理对 / A supplementary code point written as a surrogate pair

cp_to_wchars.note: 调用方需保证 `out` 至少两个元素 / The caller must provide room for two elements

hpe_plat_font_advance.brief: 取单个码点的步进宽度 / Measure the advance width of a single code point

params.codepoint: Unicode 码点 / Unicode code point

hpe_plat_font_advance.return: 步进宽度（像素），字体为空或测量失败时为 0 / Advance width in pixels, 0 when the font is NULL or measuring fails

mask_empty.brief: 构造 1×1 全透明掩码占位 / Build a 1×1 fully transparent placeholder mask

params.out: out:接收掩码的结构，被就地改写 / Mask struct rewritten in place

mask_empty.note: 用于空输入或非法输入，避免调用方处理 NULL 掩码 / Used for empty or invalid input so callers never see a NULL mask

mask_render.brief: 把宽字符串渲染到 32 位 DIB / Render a wide-character run onto a 32-bpp DIB

params.wbuf: 待渲染的宽字符 / Wide characters to render
params.wlen: 宽字符个数 / Number of wide characters
params.w: 位图宽度（像素）/ Bitmap width in pixels
params.h: 位图高度（像素）/ Bitmap height in pixels
params.out_bm: out:接收位图句柄，供调用方删除 / Receives the bitmap handle for the caller to delete

mask_render.return: DIB 像素缓冲指针，失败返回 NULL / Pointer to the DIB pixel buffer, NULL on failure
mask_render.note: 白字透明背景绘制，自顶向下；调用方负责 `DeleteObject` 位图句柄 / Draws white text on a transparent background, top-down; the caller owns deleting the bitmap handle

mask_coverage.brief: 把 32 位像素转成 8 位覆盖率 / Convert 32-bpp pixels into 8-bit coverage

params.bits: BGRA32 像素数据 / BGRA32 pixel data
params.count: 像素个数 / Number of pixels

mask_coverage.return: 新分配的覆盖率数组，调用方负责释放 / Newly allocated coverage array owned by the caller
mask_coverage.note: 每个像素取三通道最大值作为抗锯齿覆盖率 / Takes the maximum of the three colour channels per pixel as the antialiased coverage

hpe_plat_font_mask.brief: 把 UTF-8 文本渲染成 8 位覆盖率掩码 / Render a UTF-8 run into an 8-bit coverage mask

params.utf8: 待渲染的 UTF-8 文本 / UTF-8 text to render
params.len: 文本字节数 / Number of bytes
params.out: out:接收掩码的结构 / Struct that receives the mask

hpe_plat_font_mask.return: 成功返回 1，失败返回 0 / 1 on success, 0 on failure

retval.1: 掩码已写出（空输入也会写出 1×1 占位掩码）/ The mask was produced, empty input yields the 1×1 placeholder
retval.0: `GetTextExtentPoint32W` 或 DIB 创建失败 / `GetTextExtentPoint32W` or DIB creation failed

hpe_plat_font_mask.note: 覆盖区相对基线：x 从 0 起，y 在 `[-descent, ascent)`；`baseline` 为基线所在行 / Coverage is relative to the baseline: x from 0 and y over `[-descent, ascent)`; `baseline` is the row index of the baseline

hpe_text_mask_free.brief: 释放文本掩码并清零结构 / Free a text mask and zero the struct

params.mask: 待释放的掩码，NULL 时直接返回 / Mask to free, returns early when NULL
